# The register of non-conforming FerroEHR versions, kept by its
# manufacturer, Cadasto B.V. (Regulation (EU) 2025/327 Art 30(1)(o)). One
# row per finding that released versions do not conform, appended and never
# rewritten; a row is closed by filling its last column.
# A version is entered when the manufacturer considers, or has reason to
# believe, that it does not conform with Annex II or with an obligation of
# Chapter III (Art 30(1)(i)), or with an essential cybersecurity requirement
# of Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 Annex I. A vulnerability is entered once its
# advisory is published.
# Columns:
#   id                   N-<year>-<number>, in the order the findings were made
#   found                the date the manufacturer became aware, YYYY-MM-DD
#   versions             the released versions that do not conform, each X.Y.Z, separated by commas
#                        (scripts/release/withdraw.sh refuses a version this column does not name)
#   requirement          the Annex II item or the article they miss
#   summary              the non-conformity, in one sentence
#   serious_incident     yes, with the date it was reported (Art 44(7)), or no
#   cra_notified         the dates of the CRA Art 14 early warning, notification and final report, or no
#   action               corrective action, recall or withdrawal, and its timetable (docs/post-market.md)
#   corrected_in         the version that brings FerroEHR into conformity
#   authorities_told     the date and the Member States told (Art 30(1)(i))
#   users_told           the date and the route users and distributors were told (Art 30(1)(j))
#   closed               the date the finding was closed, YYYY-MM-DD
